@@ -1,41 +0,0 @@
-# Spago workspace for the Rian compiler's PureScript/purerl port (ADR-0084).
-#
-# The `backend.cmd` routes codegen through purerl (PureScript -> Erlang) instead of
-# the default JavaScript backend, so the migrated compiler runs on the BEAM and can
-# FFI to the Erlang machinery the BEAM-coupled modules need (`:compile.forms`, code
-# loading) — see ADR-0084 §"FFI boundary".
-#
-# NOTE: the package set below is the purerl set (Erlang FFI), not the default JS
-# registry set. Fetching it + the purerl binary needs a network-enabled bootstrap;
-# see purs/README.md. Until then, `purs compile` typechecks the Prim-only modules
-# offline (e.g. Rian.Token).
-package:
-  name: rian-purs
-  dependencies:
-    - prelude
-    - arrays
-    - either
-    - foldable-traversable
-    - integers
-    - lists
-    - maybe
-    - ordered-collections
-    - strings
-    - tuples
-  test:
-    main: Test.Main
-    dependencies:
-      - spec
-      - aff
-      - effect
-
-workspace:
-  # OPEN (Phase 1 blocker): purerl ships its package set as a legacy *dhall* set
-  #   https://github.com/purerl/package-sets/releases/download/erl-0.15.3-20220629/packages.dhall
-  # which spago 0.93 (registry/`packages.json`) cannot consume directly. The
-  # package-set-free slice (Rian.Token) builds + runs today via scripts/purerl-build.sh
-  # (purs → corefn → purerl → erlc, verified). Library-dependent modules (Lexer onward)
-  # need this resolved — either legacy spago (0.21, dhall) or `extraPackages` git deps
-  # generated from the dhall set. See docs/purescript-migration.md (Phase 1).
-  backend:
-    cmd: purerl
